readiness_reasons: No verified timely feed or live option chain; research-only underlying study.
No independent forward shadow sample yet; alerts must remain off.
Insufficient independent sessions (requires >=20 complete and >=5 holdout sessions).

data_availability.censoring: Candidate schedule/cooldown uses past only. Signals whose future horizon is unobservable are retained and censored from precision denominator; censored counts are reported. No inferred outcomes for outages.
data_availability.latency: Sensitivity adds 0/5/10/15 minutes to theoretical completed-bar decision time; delivery must precede target bar start. Does not measure historical publication timestamps or intraminute feed availability.

protocol.timestamps: UTC bar start; decisions and onset at completed bar close (+1 minute).
protocol.split: First 50% complete sessions train, next 25% validation, final 25% untouched test; horizon embargo at both phase boundaries.
protocol.walk_forward: Expanding earlier train sessions fit rvol quantile; next train session ranks candidates. Top two per method shortlisted by train only, validation EARLY event F1 selects one. Parameters remain fitted on train; no refit on validation/test.
protocol.event: Greedy non-overlapping forward windows: first +/- max(target_pct*close,target_atr*prior20ATR) touch within horizon; same-bar two-sided hits excluded. Onset is first completed close reaching onset_fraction of target. Windows skipped after a labeled event through anchor+horizon.
protocol.matching: One direction-matched signal per independent event between anchor and target; completed decision/delayed delivery must precede target bar start, target within signal horizon. Earliest signal matches first eligible event. Cooldown applies before future-outcome censoring. Post-onset/pre-target matches have nonpositive lead and do not count in early precision/recall or selection objective.
protocol.confidence: Wilson binomial 95% plus deterministic session-block bootstrap percentile 95%; short samples and few sessions make intervals unreliable; bootstrap is descriptive, not proof of edge.
protocol.costs: Classification only: no execution/P&L, fills, commissions, spread or slippage simulated. No claim these detections are profitable after costs, premium decay or execution latency.

limitations: Yahoo historical one-minute bars may be delayed, revised, missing or contract-roll affected. Acquisition time minus last bar time is age, not measured publication latency.
Only fully bounded observed sessions are used; opening-range feature requires 15 bars. Holidays are inferred from observed data, not modeled as complete regular sessions.
Zero-volume/malformed bars, gaps, incomplete minutes and their recent/future windows are excluded; excluded minutes can hide unobservable missed events.
Event definition and chronological partitions are predeclared engineering choices, not externally validated market truth. Greedy non-overlap omits overlapping opportunities.
Many hypotheses are compared in development. Published holdout baselines are descriptive; do not tune or select another detector after inspecting test.
Bootstrap treats sessions as blocks but sessions can remain correlated. Wilson intervals assume independent events; neither establishes statistical significance.
Completed one-minute underlying bars cannot establish pre-inflation SPX 0DTE option execution or tick-level early prediction.
